name: 55114 · Saint Paul, MN
findings: ZIP 55114 (Saint Paul) has 342 nonprofit organizations. 246 of them (72%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 180 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (49% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55114 (Saint Paul) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55114 (Saint Paul) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 24.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 180 organizations here; 11% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
